name: Golden Visa / Investor Visa (Visado de Inversores)

requirement_groups.name: Closed — fully abolished, no successor route

requirements.blocker_text: This route was fully abolished for new applicants on 3 April 2025 (Ley Orgánica 1/2025). Every investment category was removed — not just real estate. There is no successor investor route; those seeking to relocate to Spain now typically use the Non-Lucrative Visa, Digital Nomad Visa, or Entrepreneur Visa instead.

sources.title: La Moncloa — El 3 de abril entra en vigor el fin de las 'Golden Visa' (Ley Orgánica 1/2025)

notes: SECOND CONFIRMED FULL-CLOSURE CASE in this dataset, but genuinely more extreme than uk_start_up or Portugal's Sephardic route: this isn't a route that closed with a clean successor (uk_start_up → uk_innovator_founder) or a narrowing (Sephardic route closing while grandchild/great-grandchild descent stays open) — ALL investment categories were abolished simultaneously with no replacement investor route at all, hence superseded_by is explicitly null rather than pointing anywhere. MAJOR STALE-DATA FINDING, arguably the clearest and most consequential in the entire four-country-plus-Spain dataset: numerous tier-3 sites still describe Spain's Golden Visa as active, sometimes citing the specific old real-estate threshold (€500,000) as if current, or describing the closure as only affecting real estate while other categories remain — this is WRONG. La Moncloa's own announcement is unambiguous: 'deroga por completo los visados de residencia para inversores' (fully repeals investor residence visas). Existing holders granted before 3 April 2025 keep their status and can still renew under the original terms — not encoded here since this file represents the current closed-to-new-applicants state, same convention as every other closed route in this dataset. Given how frequently and confidently secondary sources get this wrong, this route is a strong candidate for the flagship 'counterfeit test' example when a user is comparing Spain's investment-migration reputation against its actual current legal status.
